description: Open-source download manager with multi-connection downloads, browser integration, video downloads and torrents.
pre_uninstall: if (Test-Path -LiteralPath "$dir\prism-native-host.exe" -PathType Leaf) { $hostExe = Join-Path $dir 'prism-native-host.exe'; try { $json = (& $hostExe status --host-path $hostExe) -join "`n"; $states = @($json | ConvertFrom-Json); $owned = @($states | Where-Object { $_.registered -and $_.pointsToThisHost } | ForEach-Object { $_.browser }); if ($owned.Count -gt 0) { & $hostExe unregister --browsers ($owned -join ',') } } catch { Write-Warning "Could not remove Prism browser integration for this Scoop installation: $_" } }
notes: Uses the upstream Windows portable ZIP, which contains prism.exe, prism-native-host.exe, portable.txt, the browser-extension files and PORTABLE-README.txt.
The portable edition stores settings, history and tools in the data folder beside prism.exe; Scoop persists that folder across upgrades.
Prism registers its browser native-messaging host for the current Windows user when the app starts. pre_uninstall removes only registrations that point to this Scoop copy.
Requires the Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime; the upstream README says it is preinstalled on Windows 10 and 11.
